# Farshid Pirahansiah

> Dr. Farshid Pirahansiah — computer vision and edge AI engineer. 21 publications, 3 patents, 12+ years turning computer-vision and deep-learning research into production systems for edge and cloud.

Every page below is a static HTML document; the markdown source is linked from each page (`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`). Cite the canonical URL shown in the link. Contact: info@pirahansiah.com · Full text of the whole site: /llms-full.txt

## Site

- [Atlas](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/atlas.html): The single index of everything on pirahansiah.com — every publication, course, note, talk and project on one page.
- [Contact](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/contact.html): Dr. Farshid Pirahansiah — computer vision & edge AI engineer.
- [Privacy](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/privacy.html): pirahansiah.com is a wholly static site. There are no analytics scripts, no cookies, no trackers, and no server-side logging of personal data.

## Publications

- [Adaptive Image Segmentation Based on PSNR for License Plate Recognition](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-adaptive-segmentation.html): Adaptive image segmentation using PSNR for license plate recognition systems.
- [AI computer vision locally LLMs on device](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-cv-meets-llm.html): Book exploring multimodal AI combining computer vision with large language models.
- [An Evaluation of Classification Techniques Using Enhanced Geometrical Topological Feature Analysis](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-geometrical-topological.html): Evaluation of classification techniques using enhanced geometrical and topological features.
- [Ant Colony Optimization for Image Edge Detection](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-ant-colony.html): ACO-based optimization for image thresholding and edge detection in OCR systems.
- [Books Opencv5 Ch3](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-opencv5-ch3.html): Advanced computer vision techniques including filtering, morphology, and G-API integration.
- [Camera Calibration and Video Stabilization Framework for Robot Localization](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-camera-calibration.html): Springer book chapter on fuzzy camera calibration and video stabilization for robot localization.
- [Camera Calibration for Multi-Modal Robot Vision](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-multimodal-calibration.html): Automatic calibration framework for multi-modal robot vision using IQA metrics.
- [Character Recognition Based on Global Feature Extraction](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-global-feature-recognition.html): Hybrid GLCM and EDMS method for character recognition in OCR applications.
- [Comparison Single Thresholding Method for Handwritten Images Segmentation](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-handwritten-thresholding.html): Comparison of PSNR and Otsu thresholding for handwritten image segmentation.
- [Computational Intelligence: From Theory to Application](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-computational-intelligence.html): Book chapter on Type-2 Fuzzy Gaussian Pyramid optical flow for video stabilization.
- [License Plate Recognition with Multi-threshold based on Entropy](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-license-plate-recognition.html): Multi-threshold license plate recognition using entropy-based image segmentation.
- [Mastering AI and Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Summary](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-opencv5-ch2.html): Comprehensive guide to AI/ML concepts, tools, best practices, and ethical considerations.
- [Mastering AI and Machine Learning: Essential Glossary, Resources, and References](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-opencv5-ch1.html): Glossary of AI/ML terms, references, and resources for computer vision practitioners.
- [Me](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/computer-vision.html): Curriculum vitae covering 12+ years of computer vision R&D, 21 publications, and 3 patents.
- [Mind Map: A Method for Detecting a Moving Vehicle](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/patents-vehicle-detection.html): Image processing method for detecting moving vehicles using CLAHE, Sobel, and geometric filtering.
- [Mind Map: Adaptive Image Thresholding Based on PSNR](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-adaptive-thresholding.html): PSNR-based adaptive thresholding for image segmentation in OCR and license plate recognition.
- [Mind Map: Character and Object Recognition Based on Global Feature Extraction](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-character-recognition.html): Global feature extraction methods for character and object recognition in computer vision.
- [Mind Map: GSFT-PSNR Global Single Fuzzy Threshold](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-fuzzy-thresholding.html): Fuzzy logic approach to global single thresholding using PSNR for image segmentation.
- [Mind Map: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio Based on Threshold Method for Image Segmentation](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-psnr-segmentation.html): PSNR-based thresholding method for image segmentation in automated visual inspection.
- [Multi-threshold Approach for License Plate Recognition System](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-multi-threshold-plate.html): Adaptive multi-threshold approach using MLP for license plate recognition systems.
- [Paper: 2D versus 3D Map for Environment Movement Objects](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-2d-3d-mapping.html): Comparison of 2D and 3D mapping approaches for environment movement detection.
- [Patent Application WO 2020/141969 A2 - Digital Advertising System](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/patents-facial-analysis.html): System for targeted digital advertising using real-time facial analysis and demographic detection.
- [Patents Face Augmentation](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/patents-face-augmentation.html): GAN-based method for augmenting face images from surveillance with fuzzy logic quality filtering.
- [Pattern Image Significance for Camera Calibration](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-pattern-calibration.html): Analysis of how pattern image design impacts camera calibration accuracy and reliability.
- [Simultaneous Localization and Mapping Trends and Humanoid Robot Linkages](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/journals-3d-slam-humanoid.html): Survey of 3D SLAM techniques for localization, mapping, and humanoid robot applications.
- [TafreshGrid: Grid Computing in Tafresh University](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/papers-grid-computing.html): Grid computing infrastructure implementation and evaluation at Tafresh University.
- [The New Developer Era: Transforming Your Career and Building Production Ready AI Agents in 2027](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/books-new-developer-era.html): Introduction to the new developer era, AI agents, and multi-agent systems.
- [Where LLMs Meet Computer Vision: Unlocking Multimodal AI](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/keynotes-llm-cv.html): Keynote on token economics, multimodal RAG, and practical CV+LLM applications.

## Notes & Guides

- [10 Years of CV Debugging Lessons](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/10-years.html): Lessons learned from a decade of debugging computer vision systems in production.
- [2025](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-llm-blog.html): Blog posts on RAG vs CAG, multi-agent architectures, AI's impact on jobs, and the future of software development.
- [Accelerate Python with Numba’s @jit(nopython=True)](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-numba.html): Tutorial on using Numba's @jit decorator to compile Python functions into optimized machine code for faster numerical computing.

- [Building a Local Video Avatar Generator Using Ollama and Open-Source Tools](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-llm-avatar.html): Build a fully local video avatar generator using Ollama LLM, Piper TTS, and Wav2Lip without cloud services.

- [How PyCUDA Reads and Runs C Kernels](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-pycuda.html): Explanation of how PyCUDA compiles and executes CUDA kernels written in C from Python, with step-by-step examples.
- [LLM Prompts for Knowledge Graph](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/prompts.html): Write ONE short sentence (max 20 words) summarising a technical note. Title: {title} Key terms: {topterms} Headings: {headings} Reply with the sentence…
- [MetaMask — Connect & Receive](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/metamask.html): Connect MetaMask to auto-fill your EVM address, send crypto, or reveal a receive address. Private test page.
- [Mind Map: Orchestrating Agents](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-llm-agents.html): Mind map and guide to orchestrating multiple AI agents for complex task completion using LLMs.
- [Mind Map: Orchestrating Agents & Advanced LLM Concepts](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-llm-concepts.html): Comprehensive mind map covering advanced LLM concepts including RAG, embeddings, multimodal models, and production deployment.
- [My Top LinkedIn Posts from the Past Year](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-linkedin-2024.html): Over the past year, my standout posts have featured camera calibration, Python, C++, OpenCV, NVIDIA optimizations, advanced C++ techniques, AI integration…
- [Note Developer Tools](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-developer-tools.html): Curated developer tools, shell essentials, Docker tips, and GitHub tricks.
- [Note Optical Flow](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-optical-flow.html): Comprehensive guide to optical flow challenges including illumination changes, occlusions, fast motion, and their solutions.
- [Note Prompt Templates](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-prompt-templates.html): Reusable prompt templates for text simplification, mind maps, and structured content processing.
- [Numba JIT Tutorial and PyCUDA with Apple Silicon Adaptation](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-apple-ml.html): Guide to Numba JIT, PyCUDA-to-Metal transition, CoreML conversion, and MLX framework on Apple Silicon.

- [Product — Embedded CV & Edge AI](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/product.html): Embedded computer vision and edge AI systems portfolio.
- [Publications — Conference Papers](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/conference-paper.html): All peer-reviewed conference papers by Dr. Farshid Pirahansiah on image processing, camera calibration, pattern recognition, and grid computing.
- [Python](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-python-configuration.html): Python configuration methods comparison plus pybind11 and Cython tips for C++ integration.
- [Real-Time 3D Point Cloud Generation and Visualization from Depth Data](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-3d-vision.html): Real-time 3D point cloud generation, depth sensing, and multi-camera synchronization for computer vision applications.
- [Real-Time Multi-Camera Vision Systems](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-multi-camera.html): Deep technical guide to building real-time multi-camera vision systems with heterogeneous processing and scaling to 100+ cameras.
- [Running K2-Horizon Locally on Apple Silicon](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/k2-horizon-local.html): Serve IFM's K2-Horizon (custom k2-horizon architecture GGUF) on Apple M3 via the MBZUAI-IFM llama.cpp fork, and wire it into Hermes Agent at 64K context.
- [Simple Setting Up a CUDA Development Environment in VS Code in Windows](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-cuda-vscode.html): Step-by-step guide to configure VS Code for CUDA C++ development on Windows with nvcc, IntelliSense, and debugging.
- [Sitemap & Page Summaries](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/menus.html): Complete navigation index with summaries of all site pages
- [Solana Arcade — Snake & Tetris](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/solana-games.html): Play Snake and Tetris in your browser, connect a Phantom wallet, and sign your high score as a cryptographic proof on Solana. No install, no account, runs…
- [Solutions — AI Courses & Workshops](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/solutions.html): AI 2026 courses, workshops, and business solutions for production-ready products.
- [Terms of Service](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/terms.html): Terms of service for pirahansiah.com: acceptable use of the content, intellectual property notice, disclaimers, and contact information.
- [The New Era of SEO: Optimizing Websites for LLMs](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/note-seo-for-llms.html): How to optimize websites for LLM-powered search engines using structured data and AI-friendly content.

## Courses

- [Advanced Programming with Modern C++ 23 for Image Processing](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-modern-cpp.html): Modern C++23 for image processing: memory management, design patterns, CUDA, and OpenCV.
- [AI Hardware Accelerators](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-ai-hardware.html): Workshop covering custom accelerators, NPUs, and edge AI chips.
- [Book Summaries](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-ai-engineers-guide.html): Book summaries and knowledge management resources.
- [Cloud-Native Infrastructure with Kubernetes](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-cloud-native.html): Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals for cloud-native infrastructure.
- [Edge AI Summit 2020 (Nov 18-20)](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-edge-ai-summit.html): Notes from Edge AI Summit covering tinyML, neuromorphic computing, and edge inference.
- [Embedded IoT](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-iot.html): Workshop on embedded IoT systems and edge computing applications.
- [Full Stack Deep Learning](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-full-stack-dl.html): Full Stack Deep Learning course notes covering ML production from data to deployment.
- [Full Stack Deep Learning 2022](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-full-stack-dl-2022.html): Notes from Full Stack Deep Learning 2022 covering ML lifecycle, data management, and continual learning.
- [IoT Scholarship Foundation](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-iot-scholarship.html): IoT and Edge AI with OpenVINO: face recognition, object detection, pose estimation, and semantic segmentation.
- [Machine Learning Specialization 2022](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-ml-specialization.html): Coursera ML Specialization notes covering regression, classification, clustering, and neural networks.
- [Metaverse & XR](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-metaverse.html): Workshop on extended reality, spatial computing, and immersive technologies.
- [MLOps — Machine Learning Engineering for Production](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-mlops.html): Coursera MLOps Specialization covering ML production, data lifecycle, modeling pipelines, and deployment.
- [OpenVINO Deep Learning](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-openvino.html): Intel OpenVINO toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models.
- [Parallel Programming](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-parallel-computing.html): Python parallel programming techniques for computer vision applications.
- [RISC-V for AI](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-risc-v.html): RISC-V open-source processor architecture for AI at the edge.
- [ROS — Robot Operating System](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-ros.html): ETH Zurich lecture on ROS architecture, navigation, simulation, and robot models.
- [TensorFlow: Data and Deployment Specialization](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-tensorflow-deploy.html): TensorFlow deployment: browser-based TF.js, device-based TF Lite, data pipelines, and optimization.
- [Tesla AI](https://pirahansiah.com/farshid/content/course-tesla.html): Workshop on Tesla's autonomous driving technology and AI systems.
